meta.description: Join Anduril and help transform U.S. military capabilities through advanced technology. We move fast, own our work, and build systems that matter.
meta.title: Careers

slices.body: This is hard work, on hard problems, in hard mode. If that isn’t for you, then that's OK. But, if you're ready to transform U.S. military capabilities through advanced tech. If you’re proud to support American warfighters. If you value working in the office or in the field. Then we want to hear from you.
slices.headline: Anduril is not a traditional defense contractor.

qualities.description: If you're not a self-starter, that's a non-starter. At Anduril, we welcome those with a vision to drive meaningful change with their work. You'll be given ownership and be expected to hit the ground running.

media.alt: An Anduril engineer operates a ruggedized laptop connected to a tactical radio unit in an outdoor field setting, embodying the company's ownership culture and self-starter ethos as they independently manage a project.

qualities.title: Autonomy

qualities.description: There’s no time for business as usual. Here, it's common for Monday's idea to become Friday's prototype. It's how we ship in months not years. The expectation is you will move at pace while upholding the quality our warfighters depend on.

media.alt: An Anduril engineer uses a power tool to assemble a large optical sensor or camera housing in a modern facility, demonstrating the company's fast-paced engineering culture of moving rapidly from concept to prototype in days.

qualities.title: Speed

qualities.description: We must Rebuild the Arsenal at hyper-scale to equip America and its allies. Joining Anduril at this stage is an opportunity to drive generational impact as we continue to accelerate, expand into new domains and forge the future of defense.

media.alt: An Anduril engineer smiles during a collaborative discussion in a hardware lab surrounded by electronic components and equipment, reflecting the energetic team culture at the forefront of rebuilding America's defense arsenal at hyper-scale and forging the future of national security.

qualities.title: Scale

qualities.description: Everyone at Anduril is responsible for meaningful, mission-driven work. This is hard tech, solving hard problems, at scale. No matter your role, your work will directly affect U.S. & allied military capabilities.

media.alt: An Anduril engineer carefully assembles a precision motor stator component at her workbench, exemplifying the hands-on, mission-driven work culture where every team member directly contributes to advancing U.S. and allied military capabilities through hard tech and complex problem-solving at scale.

qualities.title: Impact

qualities.description: This is hard, urgent work – but it's your work. You'll be given ownership and tested each and every day. Equal parts passion and perseverance are baseline requirements.
qualities.title: Grit

children.text: At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. Coverage for you and your family is available at little to no cost.
We offer comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage to support you and your family.
Our benefits include support for family planning, including fertility services, adoption assistance, gestational carrier support, and fertility preservation.
We provide competitive paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays to support rest, recovery, and personal needs.

items.title: Generous PTO, Sick Time, and Holidays

Our employee wellness program includes an annual stipend to support gym memberships, fitness, and overall well-being.
Anduril provides company-paid basic life insurance, with the option to purchase additional coverage for yourself and your dependents.

locations.description: Located in sunny Costa Mesa, California, Anduril HQ features robust facilities for software and hardware engineering, business development, and mission operations.
Anduril's Huntsville office is situated in Cummings Research Park, the second largest research park in the country, serving primarily as an engineering hub for our Rocket Motor Systems business line.

Anduril's Colorado offices are at the forefront of developing cutting-edge sensor systems and mission-enabling payloads for superior battlespace awareness. With a focus on Imaging and Battlespace Awareness, we leverage advanced software-defined sensors and high-performance computing to deliver smarter, adaptive, and cost-effective solutions. Our innovations enhance military capabilities for the US and its allies, meeting evolving threats head-on.
Anduril's Atlanta office serves as an R&D hub and manufacturing facility dedicated to advancing our UAS systems.

The Honolulu office is the home of the Edge Data Mesh program and serves as a strategic hub in the Asia-Pacific region. With a strong military presence on Oahu, our teams are agile utility players that also support key initiatives in Air Defense, Maritime, and Menace.
Anduril RMS Indiana focuses on the research, development and production of ALITEC, our next generation solid rocket fuel.

The Anduril London office is a vibrant hub for innovation and collaboration in defense technology, featuring a strong engineering presence alongside our UK & EU Business Development team dedicated to transforming military capabilities with cutting-edge solutions. Additionally, we operate the Anduril European Test & Training Site in Llanbedr, North Wales, which is specifically designed for the live testing and development of our autonomous technologies, as well as training our customers in representative environments.

children.text: Across the pond, you’ll find Anduril London and home to our EU business development team.

locations.description: Anduril Boston is an ever growing community of software engineers. Outside of the city you can find Anduril Lexington, engineers here specialize in Anduril Imaging products. A short drive away, you'll find Anduril Quincy, where the team is hard at work on our maritime products.

children.text: Anduril operates three offices in Massachusetts, with Boston as an expanding community of software engineers and Lexington specializing in Anduril Imaging products. A short drive away, you'll find Anduril Quincy, where the team is hard at work on our maritime products.

locations.description: Anduril's Rocket Motor Systems branch in McHenry, Mississippi, a short drive from the Gulf Coast, serves as the heart and soul of Solid Rocket Motor manufacturing at Anduril Industries. The McHenry facility is a testament to Anduril's modern defense ethos focused on scalable solutions, housing a $75MM+ manufacturing facility featuring cutting-edge equipment, innovative processes, and novel chemical formulations.
Located near the Raleigh Research Triangle, Anduril's North Carolina office serves as an engineering and manufacturing hub for composite R&D projects.
Columbus, Ohio is home to Arsenal-1, Anduril’s hyperscale manufacturing facility, producing tens of thousands of autonomous systems to meet growing national security needs.

Anduril's Oregon Test Site is situated on Pendleton Airport property, offering paved runways for fixed-wing operations and open hangars for our Test & Evaluation team to conduct demonstrations and execute tests for customers.

Anduril's newest production facility for Maritime is located in Quonset Point, RI. Our Manufacturing and Field Operations teams, supporting production and field testing, are expanding to meet the demands of the Dive family of products for the US and our allies.
Our Sydney office is home to software & hardware engineering, business development and manufacturing teams to support the Australian Defence Force and other customers in the Asia Pacific region.

children.text: The Sydney office hosts software and hardware engineering, business development, and manufacturing teams supporting the Australian Defence Force and other customers in APAC. Meanwhile, our Melbourne office focuses on R&D projects for new and existing programs.

locations.description: Anduril’s Reston, Virginia office is a key hub for supporting national security and defense partners, strategically located near government agencies and contractors for rapid development and deployment of innovative solutions.

With panoramic views of the Puget Sound and downtown, the Seattle office exemplifies the beauty of the PNW with a mix of nature and city life. Located in the heart of the city with many parking and public transit options nearby, the Seattle office is home to multiple teams across Software Engineering, Business Systems/IT and Talent Acquisition. Our Bellevue office thirty minutes away plays a crucial role in supporting project development and collaboration across teams, further enhancing our presence in the region.
Our DC office is strategically located near the Hill, the National Mall, and the Pentagon, housing our business development and government relations teams.

children.text: With close proximity to the Hill, the National Mall and the Pentagon, our DC office is the home of our business development and government relations teams.

locations.description: The Finland office, located 30 min from downtown Helsinki, features a 26,000 ft² ISO5 clean room dedicated to state-of-the-art optics and silicon fabrication. Equipped for both rapid prototyping and full-scale production, this facility leverages high-performance, scalable process technology to drive breakthrough R&D.

The Anduril office in Dublin is centrally located, offering easy access to the city's amenities and rich cultural heritage, fostering collaboration and innovation. Originally serving as the homebase for Klas (now Voyager), Anduril Dublin is working on the world’s most powerful edge technology. The bustling neighborhood complements the friendly, dynamic work atmosphere, making it a great place to engage with colleagues and the local community.

Established in April 2025, Anduril's Korea office is located near Cheonggyecheon stream in downtown Seoul, focusing on business development and partnerships with Korean defense stakeholders. This office focuses on building strong business relationships and exploring new opportunities. We’re committed to driving innovation and ensuring security as we work together with our Korean defense partners to shape the future.

Anduril established a presence in Taiwan in February 2025, focusing on delivering key capabilities to the Ministry of National Defense while building local supply chain operations to enhance operational capabilities and support the missiong of safeguarding national secruity.

Anduril Japan maintains a dedicated, locally incorporated footprint in the heart of Tokyo, serving as the primary interface with the Japan Ministry of Defense (JMOD), the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI), and other key stakeholders. The office fosters strategic partnerships with traditional defense OEMs and commercial manufacturers to drive market entry and growth across Anduril’s portfolio.

children.text: Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.
To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:
No Financial Requests:

Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
Please always verify communications:
Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to
contact@anduril.com
Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:

If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:
Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to
contact@anduril.com
. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.
